column_description: The exchange code for the primary trading venue of a security.
Status of the security, i.e. 'Active' or 'Inactive'. An active security is a security that has active quotes and an inactive security has no active quotes. This status changes over time.
An array of ticker symbols under which the security may be traded globally on all exchanges.
The exchange name for the primary trading venue of a security.

column_description: An array of PermIDs for the quotes for each exchange where the security is traded. An empty array means that quote information is not available.
